data.name: Freddy Frog 2
data.detailed_description:
Freddy Returns For Another Adventure

Freddy Frog is back and ready to climb higher than ever before.

Armed with incredible jumping skills and an appetite for insects, Freddy must navigate dangerous platforms, collect valuable rewards, and avoid hostile creatures on his journey upward.

The higher you climb, the greater the challenge becomes.

How far can you go?

Every Climb Is Different

No two adventures are ever the same.

Procedurally generated levels create fresh platform layouts, new opportunities, and unexpected dangers every time you play.

Adapt to constantly changing environments and discover new routes as you push for a new personal best.

Collect Flies And Black Ants

Flies and black ants can be collected throughout every run.

Gather as many as possible to increase your score and maximise your rewards.

Some collectibles are easy to reach, while others require risky jumps and careful timing.

Will you play it safe or risk everything for a bigger score?

Search For Extra Lives

Keep your adventure going by collecting valuable extra lives.

Finding additional chances can make the difference between setting a new record and seeing your run come to an early end.

Every life counts when you're aiming for the top.

Avoid Red Ants And Wasps

Not every insect is friendly.

Dangerous red ants patrol platforms while aggressive wasps threaten you from above.

Stay alert, react quickly, and avoid their attacks as you continue your climb.

One mistake could cost you a life.

Chase The Ultimate High Score

Freddy Frog 2 is easy to learn but challenging to master.

Compete against yourself, challenge friends, and climb the Steam leaderboards as you pursue the highest score possible.

Every run offers another opportunity to improve your strategy and beat your previous best.

Classic Arcade Action

Inspired by classic arcade platformers, Freddy Frog 2 combines simple controls, fast-paced gameplay, and endless replayability.

Whether you're looking for a quick game or a long high-score session, there's always a reason to come back for one more climb.

Features

  • Endless arcade climbing gameplay

  • Procedurally generated levels

  • Collect flies and black ants

  • Search for valuable extra lives

  • Avoid dangerous red ants and aggressive wasps

  • Fast-paced platforming action

  • Steam leaderboards

  • Steam achievements

  • Family-friendly gameplay

  • Easy to learn, difficult to master

  • Endless replayability

How High Can You Climb?

Freddy is ready for his next challenge.

Jump between platforms, collect every insect you can find, avoid dangerous enemies, gather extra lives, and climb higher than ever before.

Your next record-breaking run is waiting.
